effects.effect: You have a [bonus](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/bonuses-and-penalties) to [speed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/speed) equal to your [Agility](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/agility) score, and you ignore [difficult terrain](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/difficult-terrain).
